topic: What power allocation trade-offs arise from differing scan losses between quasi-TEM and quasi-TE1 modes for multi-beam satellite systems?
consensus_response: Differing scan losses between quasi-TEM and quasi-TE1 modes impact power allocation, increasing interference in quasi-TE1 mode. Adaptive power allocation mitigates this by optimizing beam powers to minimize interference and maximize signal-to-noise ratio, affecting the overall link budget and system performance.
reference_context: SatCom systems face challenges like power limitation and co-channel interference, addressed through power control and beamforming techniques.
